title: Exactness of pullback on module objects
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and $f\colon X\to Y$ any morphism of schemes. The pullback of module objects
$$
f^*=\operatorname{Ext}_{\alpha_f}\circ\operatorname{mapMod}(f^*_{\Ab})\colon\Mod_{\Lambda_Y}\to\Mod_{\Lambda_X}
$$
of [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback] is additive ([def-weil-pbc-additive-functor]) and preserves finite limits and finite colimits. More precisely, both $\operatorname{mapMod}(f^*_{\Ab})\colon\Mod_{\Lambda_Y}\to\Mod_{f^*\Lambda_Y}$ and $\operatorname{Ext}_{\alpha_f}\colon\Mod_{f^*\Lambda_Y}\to\Mod_{\Lambda_X}$ are exact ([def-galois-exact-functor]).
